label: Bible Study
prompt: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the _____.
verse: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
note: The last chapter of Exodus — Moses finishes the tabernacle, and the glory cloud moves in.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be _____.
verse: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
note: Hunger and thirst for what's right, and Jesus promises a full plate — the Beatitudes keep turning empty into filled.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come thou hither, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the _____. And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached her parched corn, and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.
verse: And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come thou hither, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached her parched corn, and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.
note: Lunch with Boaz: bread dipped in vinegar and parched corn — Ruth ate her fill and had leftovers to take home.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without _____ and without spot:
verse: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
note: Peter's ransom price: not silver or gold, but blood — the perfect lamb, without a single defect.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor _____, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
verse: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
note: Paul's list of what's 'not convenient' — not fitting — for saints ends with an upgrade: giving of thanks.
